cn.releaseNotes:
Based on your feedback, we have prepared a major update that makes Alpin Quest PRO more practical, faster and more reliable in the field. Highlights:

MAP SCREEN
- Full screen: Expand the map to the whole screen with the new button at the bottom right, and return with a single tap.
- Go to my location: A separate, larger button at the bottom right takes you back to your position with one tap.
- Loaded maps: View, manage and reorder your offline maps (MBTiles, GPKG, GeoTIFF, GeoPDF), raster KMZ files, vector layers (KML, KMZ, DXF) and GPX layers directly from the map, without opening the Load Map tab.
- Folder panel: Use the folder button at the bottom right to reach Project, Routes, Waypoints, Areas, Briefing and Tracks without leaving the map, even in full screen.
- Map grid: Choose Off, Lat/Lon or UTM/MGRS (km) in the Location tab; show line values and square names, and adjust the grid colour and thickness.

COMPASS AND LOCATION
- The compass now supports True North, Grid North and Magnetic North; manage your preference in the Location tab.
- Real-time position: Find a point by entering a bearing and distance, or create a new waypoint by bearing and distance from a saved waypoint.

WAYPOINTS, TRACKS, AREAS AND BRIEFING
- Waypoint names: The simplification in the previous update did not suit every user. You can now set waypoint names to on, off or scale-based, from the Location tab or the Waypoints tab settings.
- The Tracks tab has been redesigned: recorded tracks now have folders and bulk selection, and you can name your track when you stop recording.
- Bulk selection and bulk actions have been added to the Areas and Briefing tabs; lag in the Areas tab with large files has been fixed.

FILES AND MAPS
- Files from WhatsApp: When you open a KML, KMZ or other map file sent by a friend with the app, it recognizes the file type and takes you to the right place, or asks where you want to load it.
- Loaded vector maps can now be hidden, deleted or made transparent directly from the map.
- Hide the white background of GeoPackage maps to see the map underneath, and open several maps at the same time.
- Files with multiple records at the same location (for example samples taken in different years) are now imported completely.
- The map no longer freezes with large files containing many lines.

PDF MAP EXPORT
- The PDF export has been renewed: choose what to print on the map (waypoints, routes, areas, briefing drawings, loaded maps, your location) and the grid, and preview the PDF in the app before sharing.

HELP
- The user guide has been updated and can be opened in the app from How to Use in the side menu.

Thank you for your feedback. Have a great time in the field.

hk.releaseNotes:
Based on your feedback, we have prepared a major update that makes Alpin Quest PRO more practical, faster and more reliable in the field. Highlights:

MAP SCREEN
- Full screen: Expand the map to the whole screen with the new button at the bottom right, and return with a single tap.
- Go to my location: A separate, larger button at the bottom right takes you back to your position with one tap.
- Loaded maps: View, manage and reorder your offline maps (MBTiles, GPKG, GeoTIFF, GeoPDF), raster KMZ files, vector layers (KML, KMZ, DXF) and GPX layers directly from the map, without opening the Load Map tab.
- Folder panel: Use the folder button at the bottom right to reach Project, Routes, Waypoints, Areas, Briefing and Tracks without leaving the map, even in full screen.
- Map grid: Choose Off, Lat/Lon or UTM/MGRS (km) in the Location tab; show line values and square names, and adjust the grid colour and thickness.

COMPASS AND LOCATION
- The compass now supports True North, Grid North and Magnetic North; manage your preference in the Location tab.
- Real-time position: Find a point by entering a bearing and distance, or create a new waypoint by bearing and distance from a saved waypoint.

WAYPOINTS, TRACKS, AREAS AND BRIEFING
- Waypoint names: The simplification in the previous update did not suit every user. You can now set waypoint names to on, off or scale-based, from the Location tab or the Waypoints tab settings.
- The Tracks tab has been redesigned: recorded tracks now have folders and bulk selection, and you can name your track when you stop recording.
- Bulk selection and bulk actions have been added to the Areas and Briefing tabs; lag in the Areas tab with large files has been fixed.

FILES AND MAPS
- Files from WhatsApp: When you open a KML, KMZ or other map file sent by a friend with the app, it recognizes the file type and takes you to the right place, or asks where you want to load it.
- Loaded vector maps can now be hidden, deleted or made transparent directly from the map.
- Hide the white background of GeoPackage maps to see the map underneath, and open several maps at the same time.
- Files with multiple records at the same location (for example samples taken in different years) are now imported completely.
- The map no longer freezes with large files containing many lines.

PDF MAP EXPORT
- The PDF export has been renewed: choose what to print on the map (waypoints, routes, areas, briefing drawings, loaded maps, your location) and the grid, and preview the PDF in the app before sharing.

HELP
- The user guide has been updated and can be opened in the app from How to Use in the side menu.

Thank you for your feedback. Have a great time in the field.

真RTS + MOBA 戰鬥 + SLG微操。

「兵法如棋，局由我定！」 厌倦了數值碾壓與「看戲式」自動戰鬥？《破軍：三國》專為硬核玩家打造，回歸策略初心。這是一款純粹的三國戰略大作，極致融合 SLG 宏大佈局與 RTS 即時操作。在這裡，勝負不看課金額度，只看你的天時、地利與奇謀！

【媒體與玩家好評】 

「知略與操作的頂點，找回了單機時代策略遊戲的尊嚴。」—— 日本專業手遊站 MSY Games 

「這隻遊戲簡直是 RoK 玩家夢寐以求的微操訓練場。」—— 港台資深策略論壇玩家

【為什麼硬核策略迷一致推崇？】

  ▶ 即時指揮：搖桿微操的首創方向輪盤指揮系統，讓你在兵線對推中精準控制英雄切入。背後攻擊加成、前後夾擊收益極大化，利用繞後、包抄親手反敗為勝！

  ▶ 動態氣候：改寫戰場數據的天時地利 天氣不只是視覺。雨天道路泥濘使騎兵移速驟降，大霧是奇襲窗口，雪天雙重削減攻速。掌握天候適應力，讓自然之力為你所用。

  ▶ 奇謀逆轉：兵糧庫系統與心理戰 攻其必救，斷其糧道！攻佔敵方糧倉可瞬間瓦解全軍戰力。配合策反、離間、毒泉等奇謀戰法，實現「白板反殺名將」的史詩快感。

  ▶ 長效經營：內政自動化，下線亦能累積國力 實踐「前線征戰，後方備戰」。內政廳自動產出資源，合適的人事決策將真實回饋至全局國力。離線期間，你的大業仍在運轉。

  ▶ 匠心關卡：如詰棋般的深度戰役 拒絕重複換皮，每一關都是值得反覆琢磨的策略棋局。部署對線、地圖事件、劇情反轉，確保你的霸業征程始終充滿新鮮感。

即刻入主三國，成就你的不世霸業！

mo.description:
《守護者 OL2》是一款復古風 3D 動作 MMORPG——同一位英雄，活在兩個世界裡。與真實玩家線上冒險，或進入你的專屬單機世界按自己的節奏探索；角色、裝備與鑽石兩界通用。

【雙世界 · 同一位英雄】
· 多人世界——真實的線上大陸：組隊副本、拍賣行交易、排行榜競技
· 單機世界——按你的節奏運轉的專屬大陸：不排隊、不爭搶，只有你與隨從
· 同一份名冊——隨時切換，進度、裝備與錢包完全共享

【五大職業】
· 聖殿騎士——聖光騎士，治療與祝福是全隊的支柱
· 魔法師——身板脆弱但傷害驚人的元素主宰
· 狩魔獵人——血族神射手，精準射擊與麻痹箭控場
· 巨劍戰士——泰坦血脈的壁壘，嘲諷、盾牆與重擊
· 狂戰士——信仰火神的矮人，旋風斬橫掃敵陣

【一片值得征服的大陸】
跟隨各職業專屬主線，穿越村莊、苔原、蜘蛛洞窟與亡靈墓穴，抵達主城格蘭村——真正的獵殺從這裡開始。任務、精英怪與世界掉落遍佈每個角落。

【副本與首領】
組隊挑戰狼窩、蜘蛛巢穴、格魯爾的巢穴與黑暗地窟。每位首領——嗜血狼王、紅龍、蛛王阿巴拉克、骷髏王里昂、魔王納羅斯——都有招牌絕技：召喚、冰凍、毒素、暈眩。

【三種風險模式】
· 普通——死亡無懲罰，安心刷怪與熟悉遊戲
· 噩夢——死亡掉落金幣與魔晶，獎勵更豐厚
· 地獄——嚴厲懲罰、最頂級掉落，野外開放 PvP

【生活技能與裝備】
採礦、採藥、釣魚、狩獵——再鍛造武器、烹飪增益食物、製藥與附魔。強化、鑲嵌寶石、分解多餘裝備，打造屬於你的神裝；配方卷軸由世界掉落；集齊套裝有額外加成。

【交易、隨從與聲望】
拍賣行與其他玩家自由交易；僱傭蝙蝠、樹精、石巨人、蘑菇怪等隨從並肩作戰；與五大陣營（聖光騎士團、泰坦軍團、隱秘同盟、阿瑪斯之火、生命之源）累積聲望，兌換專屬裝備。

【每日獎勵】
登入禮包、每日特賣、每日寶箱、成就與排行榜，每次上線都有收穫。

【現已支援 18 種語言】
iOS 與 Android 同帳號互通，進度永不遺失。

mo.description:
Overwinter Survival is a card-based survival game in which you are stranded on the glaciers of Greenland.

The cold and loneliness ensnare you after your plane breaks down for an unknown reason, leaving you crashed on Greenland's glaciers and seeking shelter at a nearby cabin. Now you must hunt, craft tools and items, and keep your stove fueled to survive in the cold.

In Overwinter Survival, you must use the cards you're dealt to stay alive. You can only use one card per round. With Lady Luck at the helm, no two journeys will be the same.

Fish in the glaciers, hunt with your spear and craft an axe at your workshop to become a lumberjack. To get out of this frozen hell and see your family once again, you must stay alive and repair your plane. 

Experience a unique journey each time you play with randomly generated card decks and test your survival skills while pushing your luck amidst the frozen glaciers.

mo.description:
1851年，一位攝影師將火棉膠倒在金屬板上，在相機中曝光，並在它乾燥之前完成顯影。一張錫版，一次拍攝，沒有第二次機會。

TinType 就是那台相機，為 iPhone 而打造。

先拍攝，永不修圖。
就像攝影史上的七十年那樣，你在拍攝前就選好工具。選擇錫版、構圖，按下快門。得到的就是一張完成的濕版照片。有些錫版比其他的更出色——這就是這門工藝。

錫版
火棉膠黑白、彩色、棕褐色與暗調——每一種都帶有取自真實錫版的手工邊緣、水漬和顆粒。創作美得令人難忘、彷彿攝人心魄的肖像，以驚人的精準度忠實重現。

肖像
TinType 為拍人而生。它能找到眼睛，並將焦平面直接落在眼睛上，就像火棉膠攝影師調校相機那樣。它讀取前置與後置相機的真實景深資料，呈現盡可能真實的影像。

相機
設計靈感來自昔日的錫版相機。在你構圖時，介面甚至會隨著你的動作閃爍光澤。

照片圖庫
錫版照片以完整畫質直接存入「照片」App，永遠不會有浮水印。你可以用內建編輯工具微調錫版，點一下就能變更對焦點。

由 Hipstamatic 打造——自2009年起為 iPhone 製作相機。

** HIPSTAMATIC
** 攝影俱樂部

Based on your feedback, we have prepared a major update that makes Alpin Quest PRO more practical, faster and more reliable in the field. Highlights:

MAP SCREEN
- Full screen: Expand the map to the whole screen with the new button at the bottom right, and return with a single tap.
- Go to my location: A separate, larger button at the bottom right takes you back to your position with one tap.
- Loaded maps: View, manage and reorder your offline maps (MBTiles, GPKG, GeoTIFF, GeoPDF), raster KMZ files, vector layers (KML, KMZ, DXF) and GPX layers directly from the map, without opening the Load Map tab.
- Folder panel: Use the folder button at the bottom right to reach Project, Routes, Waypoints, Areas, Briefing and Tracks without leaving the map, even in full screen.
- Map grid: Choose Off, Lat/Lon or UTM/MGRS (km) in the Location tab; show line values and square names, and adjust the grid colour and thickness.

COMPASS AND LOCATION
- The compass now supports True North, Grid North and Magnetic North; manage your preference in the Location tab.
- Real-time position: Find a point by entering a bearing and distance, or create a new waypoint by bearing and distance from a saved waypoint.

WAYPOINTS, TRACKS, AREAS AND BRIEFING
- Waypoint names: The simplification in the previous update did not suit every user. You can now set waypoint names to on, off or scale-based, from the Location tab or the Waypoints tab settings.
- The Tracks tab has been redesigned: recorded tracks now have folders and bulk selection, and you can name your track when you stop recording.
- Bulk selection and bulk actions have been added to the Areas and Briefing tabs; lag in the Areas tab with large files has been fixed.

FILES AND MAPS
- Files from WhatsApp: When you open a KML, KMZ or other map file sent by a friend with the app, it recognizes the file type and takes you to the right place, or asks where you want to load it.
- Loaded vector maps can now be hidden, deleted or made transparent directly from the map.
- Hide the white background of GeoPackage maps to see the map underneath, and open several maps at the same time.
- Files with multiple records at the same location (for example samples taken in different years) are now imported completely.
- The map no longer freezes with large files containing many lines.

PDF MAP EXPORT
- The PDF export has been renewed: choose what to print on the map (waypoints, routes, areas, briefing drawings, loaded maps, your location) and the grid, and preview the PDF in the app before sharing.

HELP
- The user guide has been updated and can be opened in the app from How to Use in the side menu.

Thank you for your feedback. Have a great time in the field.

USNG (United States National Grid) and UTM grid systems

Tactical movement and route planning

GEOLOGY & SURVEY ENGINEERING
Area boundary determination and calculation via Polygons

KML/GPX/GeoJSON field data import/export

Custom geology map uploads in MBTiles format

UTM, USNG, QTH and decimal LAT/LON formats

Real-time coordinate conversion

Offline map downloading for field operations

Custom map uploads with MBTiles format

3D terrain view and elevation profiles

Real-time distance, bearing, and ETA to active targets

Waypoint sharing via specialized deep links

PHOTO WAYPOINTS
Document critical points with photos during operations.

MULTI-FORMAT FILE SUPPORT
GPX (waypoint, route, track) — Military and civil compatibility

KML (Google Earth) — Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiGeometry

Direct file opening from WhatsApp, Mail, and Files

Multi-point route planning

Export and share routes as GPX/KML

Speed, distance, elevation, ascent/descent statistics

Track sharing (GPX/KML format)

High-precision digital compass

Off-course indicator

Polygon area creation and editing

Automatic area import from KML (land registry/cadastre compatible)

Area calculation (m² / km² / acre / hectare)

Polygon area calculator

Distance measurement tool

《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇全新推出！誠摯邀請您踏上驚險刺激的東方宮廷權謀之旅。

新篇《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇，邀您提前鎖定這場驚心動魄的朝堂博弈，共同期待東方女帝傳奇的登頂新巔峰！

● 4K電影級質感，重塑東方宮廷美學
全程真人演繹、實景打造，結合4K電影級光影調度，匠心重現東方宮闕的恢弘氣象。從華服錦緞、金釵搖曳的細膩質感，到震撼人心的中國風配樂，全方位呈現極致東方古典美學。由官鴻、黃羿、姚弛、林小宅等知名演員傾情演出。更真實、更驚險刺激的體驗，更宏大的場景、更細膩的人物刻畫，讓盛世不再只存在於螢幕之中，而是於眼前真實展開。您將親身沉浸於「君臨天下」的東方美學盛宴！

● 從默默無聞的少女到傳奇女帝，您的劇本您來寫！
急欲掙脫命運的束縛？在本作品中，您將體驗最驚心動魄的宮廷權謀博弈！從默默無聞的少女，在多方勢力掣肘中突破困局，最終登上權力巔峰。感受運籌帷幄、制衡朝局的帝王智慧，這條逆天改命的稱帝之路，由您親手開創！

● 約1500分鐘真人演繹內容，沉浸體驗帝王人生
匠心打造的《媚娘篇》與《女帝篇》共約1500分鐘的實拍篇章，為您鋪展出一幅波瀾壯闊的盛世畫卷。面對詭譎多變的朝堂局勢，每一次落子、每一句對話，都將引發蝴蝶效應。高張力反轉、重重懸疑……在步步驚心中執掌乾坤，親手改寫王朝命運！
為您情有獨鍾或愛恨交織的角色應援助陣，誰能問鼎全球人氣榜首，皆由您一手掌控。

● 告別旁觀，真正體驗「朕即天下」
屏棄枯燥的點擊對話，深度互動玩法全面升級！權力不再只是一句空洞的台詞，而是您指尖真實運作的朝堂制衡

批閱奏摺：指尖輕點，趣解百態民生。面對層出不窮的新奇提案與市井趣事，看你如何妙筆生花、巧思破局，以奇招惠及萬民。

頒布聖旨：御筆輕懸，執掌群臣榮辱。看你如何恩威並施、論功行賞；透過封賞、發落與追貶，盡顯女帝知人善任的御人之道。

● 您是什麼類型的帝王？專屬人格測驗報告升級
在故事的終點，您還將獲得一份升級版專屬帝王測試報告！深度解析您的權謀風格、危機決策與馭人之道。究竟您是權情兼收、八面玲瓏的「絕命鶴頂紅」，還是至情至性、赴湯蹈火的「風月曼陀羅」，又或是心狠手辣、一心登頂的「卷王見手青」？在故事的最後，看見最真實的自己，並將您的專屬女帝圖鑑分享給全世界！

關於New One Studio

Based on your feedback, we have prepared a major update that makes Alpin Quest PRO more practical, faster and more reliable in the field. Highlights:

MAP SCREEN
- Full screen: Expand the map to the whole screen with the new button at the bottom right, and return with a single tap.
- Go to my location: A separate, larger button at the bottom right takes you back to your position with one tap.
- Loaded maps: View, manage and reorder your offline maps (MBTiles, GPKG, GeoTIFF, GeoPDF), raster KMZ files, vector layers (KML, KMZ, DXF) and GPX layers directly from the map, without opening the Load Map tab.
- Folder panel: Use the folder button at the bottom right to reach Project, Routes, Waypoints, Areas, Briefing and Tracks without leaving the map, even in full screen.
- Map grid: Choose Off, Lat/Lon or UTM/MGRS (km) in the Location tab; show line values and square names, and adjust the grid colour and thickness.

COMPASS AND LOCATION
- The compass now supports True North, Grid North and Magnetic North; manage your preference in the Location tab.
- Real-time position: Find a point by entering a bearing and distance, or create a new waypoint by bearing and distance from a saved waypoint.

WAYPOINTS, TRACKS, AREAS AND BRIEFING
- Waypoint names: The simplification in the previous update did not suit every user. You can now set waypoint names to on, off or scale-based, from the Location tab or the Waypoints tab settings.
- The Tracks tab has been redesigned: recorded tracks now have folders and bulk selection, and you can name your track when you stop recording.
- Bulk selection and bulk actions have been added to the Areas and Briefing tabs; lag in the Areas tab with large files has been fixed.

FILES AND MAPS
- Files from WhatsApp: When you open a KML, KMZ or other map file sent by a friend with the app, it recognizes the file type and takes you to the right place, or asks where you want to load it.
- Loaded vector maps can now be hidden, deleted or made transparent directly from the map.
- Hide the white background of GeoPackage maps to see the map underneath, and open several maps at the same time.
- Files with multiple records at the same location (for example samples taken in different years) are now imported completely.
- The map no longer freezes with large files containing many lines.

PDF MAP EXPORT
- The PDF export has been renewed: choose what to print on the map (waypoints, routes, areas, briefing drawings, loaded maps, your location) and the grid, and preview the PDF in the app before sharing.

HELP
- The user guide has been updated and can be opened in the app from How to Use in the side menu.

Thank you for your feedback. Have a great time in the field.
tw.description:
ALPINE QUEST PRO - Outdoor GPS
Alpine Quest is an advanced GPS navigation and field management application developed for military personnel, geological and survey engineers, field staff, tactical units, mountaineers, hunters, and off-road professionals. It is used worldwide with 32-language support. Using ArcGIS and QGIS project files.

MILITARY & TACTICAL USE
MGRS (Military Grid Reference System) — Full military coordinate support

USNG (United States National Grid) and UTM grid systems

DTG (Date-Time Group) time format — Zulu and local time

Military grid lines (MGRS grid overlay) on the map

Tactical movement and route planning

Full offline functionality — Operation without cellular network

All data on device — No server transfer (operational security)

GEOLOGY & SURVEY ENGINEERING
Area boundary determination and calculation via Polygons

KML/GPX/GeoJSON field data import/export

MGRS and UTM coordinate conversions

Topographic and satellite map layers

Contour (isohypse) and hillshade relief layers

Parcel/field boundary drawing with multi-point selection

Land Registry/Cadastre compatible KML format

Custom geology map uploads in MBTiles format

TACTICAL COORDINATE SYSTEMS
MGRS (Military Grid Reference System)

UTM, USNG, QTH and decimal LAT/LON formats

Real-time coordinate conversion

ADVANCED MAPPING SYSTEM
Topographic, satellite, road, and hybrid map layers

Military grid lines (MGRS grid overlay)

Offline map downloading for field operations

Custom map uploads with MBTiles format

3D terrain view and elevation profiles

TARGET & WAYPOINT MANAGEMENT
Unlimited waypoint recording and management

Manual target entry with MGRS coordinates

Real-time distance, bearing, and ETA to active targets

Waypoint sharing via specialized deep links

PHOTO WAYPOINTS
Document critical points with photos during operations.

MULTI-FORMAT FILE SUPPORT
GPX (waypoint, route, track) — Military and civil compatibility

us.description:
In 1851, a photographer poured collodion onto a plate of metal, exposed it in the camera, and developed it before it dried. One plate. One shot. No second chance.

TinType is that camera, built for the iPhone.

SHOOT FIRST. EDIT NEVER.
You decide your tools before you shoot, the way it was for seventy years of photography. Choose the plate, frame the picture, and take it. What comes out is a finished wet plate image. Some plates are better than others. That's the process.

THE PLATES
Collodion black and white, color, sepia, and dark — each with handmade edges, water marks, and grain drawn from real plates. Create hauntingly beautiful, soul-capturing portraits; faithfully reproduced with stunning accuracy.

THE PORTRAIT
TinType was built for photographing people. It finds the eyes and sets the focal plane directly on them, the same as a collodion plate photographer set their camera to do. It reads real depth from the camera — front and back — for the most authentic images possible.

THE CAMERA
Beautifully designed to mimic the tintype cameras of yore, the interface even reacts to your motion with glimmer and luster as you frame your subject.

IN YOUR LIBRARY
TinTypes save straight to Photos at full quality, with no watermark, ever. You can tweak the plates with a built-in editing suite and change the focal point with a tap.

Built by Hipstamatic, which has been making cameras for the iPhone since 2009.

** HIPSTAMATIC
** CAMERA CLUB
Unlimited TinType use is included for all Hipstamatic Camera Club Members. A standalone 'Unlimited' upgrade is also available for one-time purchase.

Overwinter Survival is a card-based survival game in which you are stranded on the glaciers of Greenland.

The cold and loneliness ensnare you after your plane breaks down for an unknown reason, leaving you crashed on Greenland's glaciers and seeking shelter at a nearby cabin. Now you must hunt, craft tools and items, and keep your stove fueled to survive in the cold.

Based on your feedback, we have prepared a major update that makes Alpin Quest PRO more practical, faster and more reliable in the field. Highlights:

MAP SCREEN
- Full screen: Expand the map to the whole screen with the new button at the bottom right, and return with a single tap.
- Go to my location: A separate, larger button at the bottom right takes you back to your position with one tap.
- Loaded maps: View, manage and reorder your offline maps (MBTiles, GPKG, GeoTIFF, GeoPDF), raster KMZ files, vector layers (KML, KMZ, DXF) and GPX layers directly from the map, without opening the Load Map tab.
- Folder panel: Use the folder button at the bottom right to reach Project, Routes, Waypoints, Areas, Briefing and Tracks without leaving the map, even in full screen.
- Map grid: Choose Off, Lat/Lon or UTM/MGRS (km) in the Location tab; show line values and square names, and adjust the grid colour and thickness.

COMPASS AND LOCATION
- The compass now supports True North, Grid North and Magnetic North; manage your preference in the Location tab.
- Real-time position: Find a point by entering a bearing and distance, or create a new waypoint by bearing and distance from a saved waypoint.

WAYPOINTS, TRACKS, AREAS AND BRIEFING
- Waypoint names: The simplification in the previous update did not suit every user. You can now set waypoint names to on, off or scale-based, from the Location tab or the Waypoints tab settings.
- The Tracks tab has been redesigned: recorded tracks now have folders and bulk selection, and you can name your track when you stop recording.
- Bulk selection and bulk actions have been added to the Areas and Briefing tabs; lag in the Areas tab with large files has been fixed.

FILES AND MAPS
- Files from WhatsApp: When you open a KML, KMZ or other map file sent by a friend with the app, it recognizes the file type and takes you to the right place, or asks where you want to load it.
- Loaded vector maps can now be hidden, deleted or made transparent directly from the map.
- Hide the white background of GeoPackage maps to see the map underneath, and open several maps at the same time.
- Files with multiple records at the same location (for example samples taken in different years) are now imported completely.

PDF MAP EXPORT
- The PDF export has been renewed: choose what to print on the map (waypoints, routes, areas, briefing drawings, loaded maps, your location) and the grid, and preview the PDF in the app before sharing.

HELP
- The user guide has been updated and can be opened in the app from How to Use in the side menu.

Thank you for your feedback. Have a great time in the field.

pt.description:
Em 1851, um fotógrafo derramou colódio sobre uma placa de metal, expôs na câmera e revelou antes que secasse. Uma placa. Um disparo. Nenhuma segunda chance.

TinType é essa câmera, feita para o iPhone.

FOTOGRAFE PRIMEIRO. NUNCA EDITE.
Você escolhe suas ferramentas antes de fotografar, como foi durante setenta anos de fotografia. Escolha a placa, enquadre a imagem e fotografe. O resultado é uma imagem de colódio úmido pronta. Algumas placas ficam melhores que outras. Esse é o processo.

AS PLACAS
Colódio em preto e branco, cor, sépia e escuro — cada uma com bordas feitas à mão, manchas de água e granulação tiradas de placas reais. Crie retratos de uma beleza assombrosa, que capturam a alma, reproduzidos fielmente com uma precisão impressionante.

O RETRATO
O TinType foi feito para fotografar pessoas. Ele encontra os olhos e coloca o plano de foco diretamente sobre eles, como o fotógrafo de colódio ajustava a câmera. Ele lê a profundidade real da câmera — frontal e traseira — para imagens o mais autênticas possível.

A CÂMERA
Projetada para imitar as câmeras de ferrótipo de antigamente, a interface reage até aos seus movimentos, com brilho e reflexos, enquanto você faz o enquadramento.

NA SUA FOTOTECA
Os ferrótipos são salvos direto no app Fotos em qualidade máxima, sem marca d’água, nunca. Ajuste as placas com o editor integrado e mude o ponto de foco com um toque.

Criado pela Hipstamatic, que faz câmeras para o iPhone desde 2009.

pt.description:
Guardian OL2 é um MMORPG de ação 3D em estilo retrô onde um só herói vive em dois mundos. Aventure-se online com jogadores reais ou explore seu Mundo Solo privado no seu ritmo — seu personagem, equipamento e diamantes acompanham você em tudo.

DOIS MUNDOS, UM HERÓI
• Mundo Multiplayer — um reino online vivo: masmorras em equipe, comércio na casa de leilões, rankings
• Mundo Solo — uma cópia privada do continente no seu ritmo: sem filas, sem competição, só você e seus seguidores
• Uma só lista — troque quando quiser; progresso, itens e carteira compartilhados

CINCO CLASSES
• Templário — cavaleiro sagrado cujas curas e bênçãos mantêm o grupo vivo
• Mago — frágil, mas devastador mestre do fogo, gelo e arcano
• Bruxo — atirador veloz do clã do sangue: tiros precisos e flechas paralisantes
• Grande Espada Guerreira — baluarte de sangue titânico: provocações, muralhas de escudos e golpes esmagadores
• Berserker — anão devoto do fogo que ceifa as fileiras inimigas em fúria giratória

UM CONTINENTE A CONQUISTAR
Siga a história própria da sua classe por aldeias, tundras congeladas, cavernas de aranhas e criptas assombradas até Grand Village, a cidade-base onde a verdadeira caça começa. Missões, elites e drops do mundo em cada canto.

MASMORRAS E CHEFES
Enfrente a cova do lobo, o Ninho de aranha, o covil orc e o Cofre escuro. Cada chefe — o rei lobo sanguinário, o Dragão Vermelho, abrak a aranha, o Rei Esqueleto Leon, o Rei Demônio Naros — traz seu truque: invocações, congelamento, veneno, atordoamento.

TRÊS MODOS DE RISCO
• Normal — sem penalidade de morte; perfeito para aprender
• Pesadelo — morrer custa moedas e cristais; loot e XP melhores
• Inferno — penalidades brutais, os melhores drops e PvP em mundo aberto

OFÍCIOS E EQUIPAMENTO
Minere, colete ervas, pesque e cace — depois forje armas, cozinhe pratos com bônus, prepare poções e encante equipamento. Aprimore, encaixe gemas e desmonte o excedente. Pergaminhos de receitas caem no mundo. Conjuntos dão poder extra.

COMÉRCIO, SEGUIDORES E FACÇÕES
Venda seu loot para jogadores reais na casa de leilões. Contrate seguidores — morcegos, dríades, golems, cogumelos — para lutar ao seu lado. Ganhe reputação com cinco facções (Cavaleiros da luz, Legião Titã, Aliança oculta, Fogo de armas, A fonte da vida) e troque por equipamento exclusivo.

RECOMPENSAS DIÁRIAS
Presentes de login, ofertas diárias, baús diários, conquistas e rankings do servidor fazem cada sessão valer a pena.

AGORA EM 18 IDIOMAS
A mesma conta funciona em iOS e Android — o progresso nunca se perde. Jogo premium: pague uma vez, sem anúncios. Compras opcionais no app (diamantes, assinatura) disponíveis.
